name: 2 Samuel
lede: The tenth book of the Bible, in full: David king in Hebron and in Jerusalem, the ark brought up with dancing, Bath-sheba and Nathan, Absalom's rebellion, and the threshing-floor of Araunah, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: How Are the Mighty Fallen
books.blurb: The Amalekite out of Saul's camp with the crown and the bracelet; David rends his clothes; the song of the bow — how are the mighty fallen!; David anointed king over Judah in Hebron and Ish-bosheth made king at Mahanaim; the twelve by the pool of Gibeon, Asahel light of foot as a wild roe, and Abner's cry: shall the sword devour for ever?

books.name: Abner
books.blurb: Long war between the house of Saul and the house of David; Abner's wrath — am I a dog's head?; Michal taken from Paltiel, who followed her weeping to Bahurim; Abner's league and the feast in Hebron; Joab takes him aside in the gate; David follows the bier: should Abner die as a fool dieth?; Mephibosheth lamed in the flight, and Ish-bosheth slain at noon.
